verifications.note: 江西省发改委2013年天然气利用规划政策文件(24页PDF), p.3: "省级天然气长输管道.承接川气东送工程气源的江西省天然气管网一期工程已建成管道870公里，主要建成九江一南昌、九江-沙河、九江-景德镇、南昌-丰城、高安-新余、丰城-抚州6条干线和田南-上高支线。" — states the Jiangxi provincial gas pipeline network Phase I (870 km) is already built (已建成), naming Tiannan-Shanggao (田南-上高) as the branch line (支线) completed alongside the 6 trunk lines. 已建成 (built/completed, supplying downstream cities per the same document) supports 'operating' by context per the status-inference rule.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Single verified source: Jiangxi provincial DRC (发改委) natural-gas-utilization planning document (2013), reposted on qianzhan.com, explicitly names 田南-上高 as the completed Phase I branch line and states the network is 已建成 (built). Second-source hunt: (1) the wiki page's own footnote [5] for this segment's status is https://www.nc.gov.cn/ncszf/jggl/201907/6a89f3a94e294aa0b8efe4957d9fb3b3/files/5860135c817f4c8e9ecaaee88d305729.pdf — confirmed dead (DNS resolution failure live via curl with a browser UA, zero Wayback CDX captures for this URL); (2) the wiki's separate length/capacity/start citation for this segment, footnote [15] pipechina.com.cn xls, is also dead (HTTP 404 live via url_verifier, zero Wayback CDX captures), so no fallback via that document either; (3) the row's other 'already on row' candidate refs (huaon.com/channel/trend/624729.html, petrobest.com/success_info.php?cid=74) were fetched and read in full — both describe the Jiangxi network only at the province/system level and never name Tiannan-Shanggao specifically, failing the name-the-pipeline requirement (rule 4a); (4) session WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200) attempting a targeted '田南-上高 天然气 支线' search; Bing and Baidu were scraped directly via curl as a fallback and returned no usable result content. No second independent source could be recovered despite this escalation ladder — tier held at medium on a single but page-verified, name-matched, regulatory-origin source.

verifications.note: Same passage as the Status verification: the document is titled/framed throughout as 江西省天然气利用规划 (Jiangxi Natural Gas Utilization Plan) and describes 田南-上高 as a branch of the 江西省天然气管网 (Jiangxi provincial natural-gas pipeline network), i.e. explicitly a natural-gas (天然气) line.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Same source and same second-source-hunt outcome as the Status unit above (see that entry) — a provincial NATURAL GAS pipeline planning document by construction, so Fuel=Gas is stated by the document's own subject matter. No independent second source located.

verifications.note: "...6条干线和田南-上高支线。" — Tiannan-Shanggao is explicitly named as the '支线' (branch/lateral line) of the same long-distance (长输) provincial gas pipeline network whose 6 other segments are the trunk (干线) lines. A branch/lateral of a high-pressure long-distance transmission network (as opposed to a low-pressure urban distribution network, which the same document discusses separately under 城市天然气基础设施) maps to GEM's 'transmission' classification, consistent with the recorded value; noting for the record that the document itself distinguishes 支线 from 干线, which is a lateral-vs-trunk distinction within transmission, not a transmission-vs-distribution one.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Same source and second-source-hunt outcome as the Status unit above. The document's own vocabulary (省级天然气长输管道 / 支线 of that long-distance network) supports 'transmission' as recorded — flagging only that it is a lateral rather than a trunk line within the same transmission network, not a basis to change the classification. No independent second source located.
